verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a dedicated stablecoin-acceptance flow: you enable the Crypto payment method, the customer chooses a stablecoin (USDC, USDP, USDG), a wallet and a network, and completed payments settle as fiat in your Stripe balance, with refunds supported. A community comment corroborates that settlement is effectively instant. Programmatic payment creation and settlement confirmation are only implied by the payment-method integration, not shown explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the API objects or endpoints used to create the stablecoin payment, documented programmatic settlement confirmation (e.g., webhook events for crypto payments), hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end integration.
